name: Gomorrah

identification.note: Like Sodom, likely near the Dead Sea, but no site is confidently confirmed.

related_people.name: Birsha
related_people.role: its king, defeated with the allied kings of the plain in the Valley of Siddim

description: A city of the plain, allied with Sodom under its king Birsha, destroyed alongside it by fire and sulfur from heaven for its wickedness (Genesis 14:2; 19:24-28).
